## What's new

- **Quit means off.** Quitting RayLink now also disconnects. Closing the window keeps RayLink connected in the tray, as before.
- **Quiet when closed.** On Windows and Linux, RayLink's background service now stays idle while the app is closed: no connection, no updates, no network traffic.
- **Instant quit on Windows.** RayLink closes right away from the tray instead of after several seconds.
- Stability improvements.
